steps.title: Analyze and Define Project Structure
steps.description: Establish the standard Android Native project structure for 'Modern Calculator' with package 'com.moderncalculator.app'.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Configure 'app/build.gradle' with SDK version 34, Java 1.8 compatibility, and remove all non-SDK/third-party dependencies to ensure full compliance.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest File
steps.description: Define the app's application node, main Activity launch configuration, and correct launcher icon assets under the official Android namespace.

steps.title: Define Color Resources
steps.description: Establish beautiful premium colors in 'colors.xml' including dark minimalist background shades, active accents, and neutral operator tones.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Establish key localizable string variables inside 'strings.xml' to define text contents.

steps.title: Design Rounded Number Button Shapes
steps.description: Create a custom drawable 'btn_number_bg.xml' containing a perfectly circular button state list selector with interactive press feedback.

steps.title: Design Rounded Operator Button Shapes
steps.description: Create a custom drawable 'btn_operator_bg.xml' for operational keys featuring premium active amber highlight colors.

steps.title: Design Rounded Function Button Shapes
steps.description: Create a custom drawable 'btn_function_bg.xml' for auxiliary controls featuring neutral light slate finishes.

steps.title: Implement Elegant Display & Keypad XML Layout
steps.description: Construct 'activity_main.xml' with a double-tiered display (history and expression) and an aligned keypad containing 19 beautiful buttons.

steps.title: Bind UI Elements & View Click Listeners
steps.description: Set up 'MainActivity.java', bind displays, and register button click listeners using Java 8 compatible anonymous classes.

steps.title: Develop Numeric Input Flow with Length Limits & Auto-Scaling Display
steps.description: Implement robust numerical input handling with a 15-digit limit to protect screen space and prevent floating-point parse exceptions, plus dynamic font size auto-scaling.

steps.title: Implement Continuous Arithmetic Operations
steps.description: Develop automatic chain-operation resolving when successive operators are clicked without needing the equals key.

steps.title: Add Edge Case Protections & Live Displays
steps.description: Configure zero-division protection, clear/soft-clear triggers, scientific rounding filters, and live expression display updates.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the code using Gradle and create the completed release package with beautiful native assets.
